title: Record a stage gate that already happened with its original time, quoted evidence and a backfilled flag that timing reports separately (DRIVE-5)
description: Record a stage gate that already happened with its original time, quoted evidence and a backfilled flag that timing reports separately (DRIVE-5)
acceptance_criteria: Source: Leif's brief t811u item 5, "Want: `chough stage backfill` (or similar) that records a past gate with its original time, the approval evidence (commit, quoted choice), and a backfilled flag that `timing` reports separately.", quoted as DRIVE-5 and confirmed as his criteria at 5:24 PM MST (card t811s9271); the parent relayed at 6:03 PM MST that the hard rule holds: it records a past gate's original time, the quoted evidence and a backfilled flag that timing reports separately, never creates a human approval or review record, and refuses if the native state doesn't support the gate. Outcomes: (1) chough stage backfill --at <UTC time or unix seconds> --commit <rev> --quote <text> [--note <text>] makes the move advance would make now, to the next main stage, and records it as an advance transition whose time is the given past time and which carries backfill {recorded_at_unix_seconds, commit (full SHA), quote}; (2) it applies every refusal advance applies (inactive or side stage, open awaiting-human gate, blocking bugs and unlinked failures leaving test, and the destination's native prerequisite read now), so native state still decides the gate; (3) it refuses with nothing recorded a time in the future, a time before the latest recorded transition, an unreadable latest transition, a commit that does not resolve or is not an ancestor of HEAD, a blank or oversized quote, and the release to done move; (4) it records no human approval, review, consent or awaiting-human gate, and its output says the quote is evidence only; (5) timing lists backfilled moves separately with their recorded time, commit and quote, marks segments a backfilled move bounds, reports their backfilled time per stage, and leaves them out of estimate samples; (6) records without backfill keep their exact bytes, and the legacy log and history events both carry it; (7) docs, CHANGELOG and the lifecycle skill reference describe it; (8) the new tests fail before the change and fledge lanes run verify passes

answers.constraints: No new dependency; transition records without backfill keep their exact bytes; no change to any existing stage gate, to native reads or to the cli spec (its requirements companion is near the 65536-byte bound), so the requirement goes in the history module; the hard rule holds: Chough records no human approval or review and native SpecSync state decides the gate
